description: Recursive replacement translates a propositional formula into each standard complete basis while preserving every valuation value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.toBasis_correct.{u} {α : Type u} (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropBasis)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InBasis b (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.toBasis b A) ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.toBasis b A) A
